Resolved the independent review's P2 censored-run diagnostics bug. Gls.diagnostics now pads coefficient vectors to the common diagnostic AR order before averaging and validation. Native IID filters retain empty phi/order 0 and NotAttempted outcomes. Regressions cover AR(1)/AR(2) across global, run and voxelwise pooling, native IID preservation, dense/bounded equality at block sizes 1, 2 and 4, and the existing raw-pooling diagnostic representation.

Fresh full fit gates: fitJVM/test 704 passed; fitJS/test 647 passed; zero compiler warnings/errors. The same independent reviewer rechecked the remediation, confirmed the original P2 is resolved and reported no new actionable findings. No changes to estimation, whitening kernels, R oracles or correction statuses. Broader unchanged-source evidence remains in the original receipt.

Updated audit: docs/audits/ar-fmriar-fmrireg.md. New source-bound remediation receipt/log: docs/verification/ar-consumer-closure-20261007/censor-fix/summary.json. Original review evidence is retained. Changes remain uncommitted; mote remains review.
